tasks.description: A list of netwox tasks to execute. Each task defines a tool number, an action, and optional parameters or flags.

tasks.items.description: Definition of a single netwox task instance within the tasks list. Note: Since the schema requires flat maps for items, we define the fields of the object here, but the actual implementation in a Jinja2 loop treats the list items as dictionaries. The schema below defines the structure of each dictionary item in the list.

tasks.items.name.description: A human-readable name for the task.

tasks.items.tool_number.description: The numeric identifier of the netwox tool to run (e.g., 23 for TCP SYN Flood, see netwox documentation).

tasks.items.action.description: The action to perform: 'run' to execute the tool, 'help' for simple help, 'help2' for extended help.

tasks.items.extended.description: If true, passes the -e/--extended flag to the netwox command.

tasks.items.parameters.description: A list of string arguments to pass to the netwox tool after the tool number.
